SELECT scenes.scene_index, scenes.title, scenes.goal, scenes.core_conflict, scenes.emotional_beat, scenes.must_happen, scenes.must_not_happen, scenes.narrative_tag, scenes.source, scenes.scene_chunks, scenes.chapter_ids, scenes.pov_character_id, scenes.structure_meta, scenes.id, scenes.created_at, scenes.updated_at, scenes.status, scenes.novel_id
